metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for product, UX and delivery workflows, published from a production Nx monorepo.

plugins.name: giga-ux
plugins.description: UX architecture and review: wireframe a feature before its visual design, review it in the running app after it is built, with blind first-click and expectation tests.

plugins.name: giga-workflow
plugins.description: Jira epic workflow: plan an epic into waves, take one story at a time from ticket to merged PR, or run a whole board unattended — with plan files, a refactor-when-touched gate, UX review and cross-actor testing.

plugins.name: giga-angular
plugins.description: Angular skills: Storybook stories against your own review container, component state in a colocated NgRx SignalStore, global NgRx store slices, new-domain scaffolding with Nx generators, theming and accessibility checks, and design-library promotion, all following your repo's configured conventions.

plugins.name: giga-standards
plugins.description: Write-time coding standards: when an agent writes a file, inject the constraints sections, anti-patterns, standards fragments and library notes that govern it, routed by a table in your repo's config, under a size budget, once per agent context.
